title: Yamunotri Dham Darshan
style: 3D animated devotional movie style, Pixar quality, soft cinematic lighting, rich warm colours, no text, no letters, no writing
hook: Yamunotri Dham: Bhai Dooj par kapat?

scenes.prompt: Close-up devotional darshan of Maa Yamuna, a serene dark-complexioned goddess with a gentle face in the middle of the frame, golden crown, marigold garlands, standing on a tortoise, holding a water pot, in a small Himalayan temple sanctum, soft golden glow
scenes.tts: यमुनोत्री धाम में भाई दूज पर कपाट क्यों बंद होते हैं?
scenes.sub: Yamunotri Dham mein Bhai Dooj par kapat kyon band hote hain?
scenes.animate: a very slow gentle camera push-in, the face stays still and serene, the soft golden glow gently pulses, a few marigold petals drift in the foreground

scenes.prompt: A small traditional stone Himalayan temple of Yamunotri among snow-capped mountains and pine forest at sunrise, a river valley below, soft golden light, no people
scenes.tts: यह उत्तराखंड में है, माँ यमुना का धाम।
scenes.sub: Ye Uttarakhand mein hai, Maa Yamuna ka dham.
scenes.animate: light mist drifts slowly over the mountains and the river water flows gently

scenes.prompt: Maa Yamuna as a river goddess and her brother Yamraj, calm and kind, standing side by side near the river bank, she applies a tilak on his forehead, soft warm light, devotional illustration
scenes.tts: यम और यमुना, भाई-बहन। भाई दूज की कथा इन्हीं से जुड़ी है।
scenes.sub: Yam aur Yamuna, bhai-behan. Bhai Dooj ki katha inhi se judi hai.

scenes.prompt: A decorated traditional palanquin carrying the murti of Maa Yamuna, covered with marigold garlands, carried gently down a mountain path in the soft morning light, snowy peaks behind, no faces visible
scenes.tts: भाई दूज पर माँ की डोली खरसाली जाती है, सर्दियों के घर।
scenes.sub: Bhai Dooj par Maa ki doli Kharsali jaati hai, sardiyon ke ghar.
scenes.animate: marigold garlands sway softly and light mist drifts across the mountain path

scenes.prompt: Close-up of Maa Yamuna murti, serene face in the middle of the frame, golden crown, marigold garlands, glowing diyas in the foreground, decorated sanctum
scenes.tts: अक्षय तृतीया पर कपाट फिर खुलते हैं।
scenes.sub: Akshaya Tritiya par kapat phir khulte hain.
scenes.animate: a very slow gentle camera push-in, the face stays still and serene, the diya flames glow and flicker softly

scenes.tts: कल एक और मंदिर के दर्शन के लिए लाइक, शेयर, सब्सक्राइब करें। जय यमुनोत्री धाम!
scenes.sub: Kal ek aur mandir ke darshan ke liye Like, Share, Subscribe karein. Jai Yamunotri Dham!
